name: Vermont

period.description: If you live at home, you get six months to meet your spenddown, starting the first of the month you apply.

submission.description: Tell DVHA about your medical costs and send proof: upload with the online Document Uploader, fax, or mail to the Application and Document Processing Center in Waterbury.

notes: Unpaid bills you still owe count, and so do bills you paid during the six-month period.
Health insurance premiums count toward the spenddown.
No medical bill can be used more than once.
About five business days after sending papers, call 1-855-899-9600 to check they arrived.
